column1: # Tools/reactivity.py --voices (plan 26.11.2026, I1): per voice of the screening music, the full run against the run with that voice muted (pan: the lead hard left).  amp = mean |difference| in % of full scale, struct = after per-frame normalisation, sync = the change the voice adds against its own hits (0..1), hit = the hit-locked part of the frame change in % per frame, lr = left half brighter than right in %, lim = limiter samples dimmed (of 12 s), zero = the voices read no more than ProfileStill's floor (kick, snare, hat, bass: sync < 0.15 or hit < 2.0 x floor; lead: amp and struct < 2.0 x floor; pan: |lr| < 0.10).
